root.statement: Integrate the licensed Quaternius gun pack into real KYX weapon slots without changing combat authority or presenting a broken doubled first-person model.
root.source_state: Only the VLR rifle donor was integrated; the remaining product slots used procedural presentation and prior fitting attempts produced oversized or detached views.
root.target_state: Five product gun slots load one exact verified imported model each in Practice and staging-review, with a clean WIP first-person contact and explicit human-acceptance nonclaim.
conditions: Preserve Worker and practice combat semantics.
Keep exactly one visible first-person weapon root.
Human visual acceptance remains reserved to the owner.
root.boundary: KYX staging-review weapon presentation, source Blender derivatives, package closure, and local Practice evidence only.

intent.summary: Put the selected gun pack into the actual desktop game for tester use.

decision.summary: Use four CC0 donors for sidearm, shotgun, sniper, and launcher while retaining the existing rifle donor.

acceptance_contract.summary: Functional/runtime proof may expose a WIP candidate; final visual and animation acceptance remains human-reserved.

mechanism.summary: Verified GLBs install as presentation-only shell factories over hidden procedural meshes while existing muzzle and authority markers remain authoritative.

current_state_history.summary: v1 was oversized, v2-v4 exposed fit/contact defects, and v5 removes the detached second-contact failure.

people_incentives.summary: The owner wants an immediately walkable tester build and prefers visible progress over isolated art renders.

lifecycle_recovery.summary: The integration is isolated on a WIP branch and can be reverted as one bounded commit; production is excluded.

invariants.statement: Imported presentation must not change damage, cadence, ammo, muzzle, hit, or Worker authority.
Every product slot renders exactly one first-person weapon root with no legacy overlap.
Every imported donor must have exact source identity and reuse rights.
Automated proof must not self-grant visual or animation acceptance.
